title: Seva to Hukam
subtitle: A cross-linked bridge between two recurring pressures
description: Guru joins service to humility, honest labor, and offering rather than display. This bridge then carries into guru reframes peace as understanding the command already holding everything.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Selfless service becomes a way of union, not a way of building a self-image.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Serve without building a story about being the servant.
